conviction_note: Nothing new or decisive turned up. The documents point both ways. Management guided second-half revenue above the first half and lower opex. Against that, revenue is bound to fall year on year because Q3 2025 ($5.1m) included a $1m perpetual-licence expansion, and current deferred revenue at June 30 was down 11.5% YoY. The name has fallen after 6 of its last 7 prints. So p_up 45 on an abs move of 8%: the 5.95% median is scaled up for about $28k of daily turnover and a sub-$1 price. The findings sum (-1.1) and the scaled number (-0.8) agree in sign and size.
bar: Unsourced as a number. No Q3 2026 consensus was found (Seeking Alpha and Digrin are paywalled; VCP Scanner, updated 2026-06-28, shows 0 covering analysts: https://vcpscanner.com/stock/awre/price-target). One aggregator snippet put Q2 consensus at $3.7m revenue and -$0.10 EPS (https://www.opencapital.sh/stocks/awre/earnings/q2-2026, page returned 403, snippet only). The only company bar is qualitative: H2 2026 revenue above H1 (H1 = $3.4m + $3.25m = $6.65m) and lower H2 opex from $4m of annualised cuts (Q2 call 2026-07-29: https://www.webull.com/news/15364343962084352). Every finding is capped small for this reason.
positioning_check: Short interest is tiny and stale. 70.0k shares short with 1.9 days to cover at the 2026-07-15 FINRA settlement, about 0.3% of 21.8m shares (search snippet citing https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/awre/short-interest/, page 403; Equibles has about 0.16% of float: https://equibles.com/stocks/awre/shortinterest). Not a crowded short. No usable option chain: total OI 12 and ATM not two-sided, so skew and implied move are null (sealed baseline). Tape: spot $0.8964, -19.96% over 20 days, -64.6% from the 52-week high, +6.7% off the 52-week low. 20-day average volume is 30,845 shares, about $28k a day.

findings.finding: On the Q2 call (2026-07-29) management said H2 2026 revenue will exceed H1 ($6.65m) and H2 opex will be lower as $4m of annualised cuts (started Q2) take full effect. So Q3 operating loss should narrow from Q2's $2.7m, and a Q3 near or above $3.3m sits inside the guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After Q2 2026, with H2 > H1 guided, the stock rose +3.6%, the only up reaction in 7 prints (baseline). Q3 2025 revenue +33% still fell -5.95%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: it is the company's own guide and lands inside it. The stock fell from about $1.25 in August to $0.90 with no news, so the market is not paying for a second-half recovery. If it were, the stock would not sit about 20% below its post-Q2 level and near cash.
findings.independence: Same guide restated in biometricupdate's 2026-07-30 coverage (https://www.biometricupdate.com/202607/aware-focussed-on-public-sector-opportunity-for-biometrics-orchestration-platform). Same source event, so one finding.

findings.finding: Q3 2025 revenue was $5.1m (+33% YoY), including a one-time $1m perpetual-licence expansion with an existing customer and $0.6m of new term licences. Unless a large licence lands, Q3 2026 revenue will be headlined as a YoY decline. Q1 and Q2 2026 were down 6% and 16%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: YoY revenue declines in Q4 2025, Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 drew -6.55%, -20.55% and +3.6% (baseline; Q1 reaction per Zacks 'Aware Stock Dips Post Q1 Earnings, Revenue Declines Y/Y', https://www.metatrader.com/fr/news/1578611-aware-stock-dips-post-q1-earnings-revenue-declines-yy).
findings.why_not_priced: The comparison is mechanical and public, but this name's thin base trades on the Zacks/wire YoY headline. If the market had priced a clean sequential read, the last three YoY-decline headlines would not have drawn mostly negative reactions.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 10-Q shows software licences falling to $954k from $1,420k YoY (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1015739/000119312526328344/awre-20260630.htm). This is a different document confirming licence softness.

findings.finding: Current deferred revenue was $3.462m at 2026-06-30, against $3.911m at 2025-06-30 (-11.5% YoY) and $4.025m at 2024-06-30. It is the lowest June level in the series. Q2 maintenance revenue fell 7% YoY ($1,998k vs $2,148k). The recurring base going into the Q3 renewal season is shrinking.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior reaction is attributable to deferred revenue specifically. Recurring-revenue softness was cited alongside the -20.55% Q1 2026 reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: The figure has been in the 10-Q since 2026-07-31, but no coverage read the YoY deferred-revenue walk. Coverage summarised recurring revenue as 'roughly flat at $2.7m'. If it had been priced, the post-Q2 reaction would not have been the only up move in seven prints.
findings.independence: Q2 10-Q revenue table (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1015739/000119312526328344/awre-20260630.htm). Same filing family as finding 2's corroboration but a different line (maintenance vs licences).

findings.finding: The CEO (Ajay Amlani) made open-market purchases between 2026-07-31 and 2026-08-12, about 26.6k shares at $1.18-1.26 (Form 4s filed 2026-08-04, 08-07, 08-12). They were made after the Q2 print with knowledge of July and August trading, and he is now underwater at $0.90.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and small (about $33k). The stock has fallen about 28% since, so the signal has not supported the price. That is weak evidence it is priced or uninformative.
findings.independence: Further purchases on 2026-08-05/06 and 08-11/12 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1015739/000119312526340202/ownership.xml, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1015739/000119312526347341/ownership.xml) are the same insider, so one finding.

findings.finding: Market cap is about $19.6m (21.81m shares x $0.8964). Cash and securities were $16.84m at 2026-06-30, with no debt and H1 operating cash burn of $5.44m. Estimated September 30 cash is about $14m, so the operating business is valued at roughly $5m at about 0.4x sales.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None. The same cash-backed setup existed before the -20.55% Q1 reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Cheapness is visible to anyone, so it is not an edge. It only bounds the downside on a bad print. Zacks already flagged EV/Sales of about 0.4x in April and rated it Underperform (https://www.metatrader.com/it/news/1508545-awre-downgraded-to-underperform-on-delayed-conversions--cash).

findings.finding: The stock closed at $0.8405 on 2026-10-15 and $0.8964 on 2026-10-28, below Nasdaq's $1.00 minimum bid. EDGAR shows no deficiency-notice 8-K through the last filing on 2026-09-24. The release or call could disclose a notice or reverse-split plans.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance for this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The price is public, but a 30-business-day breach has probably not run yet, so no notice exists to price. The date the stock first closed below $1 is unverified, so this may resolve after the window.

findings.finding: The DHS-only funding lapse ran from 2026-02-14 to about 2026-04-30. On the Q2 call the CEO cited DHS funding disruption and said public-sector business development was up. Q3 contains the federal fiscal year-end (September), and a CR averted any lapse at the start of FY2027 (signed early September). Federal licence timing therefore had a clean window in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Federal procurement delays were cited for the Q2 decline. No reaction is attributable to a federal win.
findings.why_not_priced: This is macro-to-company transmission the company has not confirmed. No Aware federal award was announced from August to October, which argues it has not converted. The size is small for that reason.
findings.independence: Proxy only. The CEO's DHS comment is at https://www.biometricupdate.com/202607/aware-focussed-on-public-sector-opportunity-for-biometrics-orchestration-platform, and the FY2027 CR at https://spacepolicyonline.com/news/house-clears-fy2027-cr-now-to-the-president/.

findings.finding: The 2026-06-09 release slated general availability of the upgraded Awareness Platform (ROC and Mitek integrations, Intelligent Matching) for Q3 2026. Searches found no GA press release or new named platform customer from August to October 2026, so the call may report slippage or only pipeline.
findings.why_not_priced: The absence of a release is weak evidence because companies often announce GA on the call. The size is small.
